name: buwiz-app
description: Native Buwiz tax app with a Zig calendar engine and SQLite policy store.

scripts.generate: npm run generate:tax-catalog && npm run generate:postal-reference && node scripts/flatten-native.mjs
scripts.check:postal-reference: npm run typecheck:postal-reference && npm run test:postal-reference && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/postal-reference/generate.ts --check
scripts.check:tax-catalog: npm run typecheck:tax-catalog && npm run check:field-ownership-manifests && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/tax-catalog/generate.ts --check

//: --experimental-strip-types is required on Node 22.15, the documented minimum. Node 22.18+ and 23.6+ strip types by default and accept the flag as a no-op, so one invocation covers every supported runtime.
